messages:
maria: FYI customer on Dedicated found a discrepancy between the console audit viewer and exports. In the viewer key.rotate events show a kms.key_id and service account actor, but the CSV export has empty kms_key and actor columns. JSON export includes the fields sometimes. Repro steps attached / they hit Export -> CSV. @alex @jordan :eyes:

alex: Thanks. Can you paste a minimal sample (JSON + resulting CSV row)? Also are they using Console export or the API export?

maria: sample below (sanitized):

```json
{
  "event_type": "key.rotate",
  "timestamp": "2026-11-02T14:23:01Z",
  "actor": {
    "principal": "service-account:svc-123",
    "principal_type": "service_account"
  },
  "resource": {
    "id": "cred-789"
  },
  "context": {
    "kms": {
      "key_id": "projects/prod/locations/us/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key-abc"
    }
  },
  "request_id": "req-555"
}
```

CSV they got from Console Export (first row):

```
event_type,timestamp,actor,actor_type,resource_id,kms_key,request_id
key.rotate,2026-11-02T14:23:01Z,service-account:svc-123,,cred-789,,req-555
```

maria: notice actor_type and kms_key blank. JSON export sometimes includes kms.key_id but not always (depends on timeframe they said).

jordan: frontend: the Console export currently streams a paginated query to backend and flattens events to CSV. We recently switched to the "compact" search mode when exporting to reduce payload. Compact mode drops nested fields unless explicitly mapped. Also the export button is visible to users with read-only "audit.viewer" role, but the actual CSV write permission should be gated on a separate "audit.export" perm — could be an RBAC mismatch.

samir: infra/platform: the export backend calls audit-search:v1 with query param compact=true and page_size=500. That API returns `next_cursor` sometimes but the exporter only reads `next_page_token` (old name). So pagination can stop early (customer's long time range = multiple pages). Also compact=true collapses nested JSON to top-level paths only when we send a schema mapping; we never added mapping for context.kms.key_id or actor.principal_type.

alex: Ok action plan: 1) Fix pagination token name mapping (support both next_cursor and next_page_token). 2) Remove compact=true for Console exports until we have a safe mapping OR extend compact mapping to include actor.principal_type, context.kms.key_id, request_id. 3) Add RBAC check in UI: hide Export button unless user has audit.export permission. 4) Confirm KMS normalization/redaction policy with Compliance.

olivia: Compliance: confirming that KMS key resource names (key_id) are allowed in audit exports for customers that own the keys. We must not include any plaintext key material. For cross-tenant hosts we need to normalize names and replace project IDs with placeholders unless tenant-scoped. We also want an explicit field kms.key_id and a normalization rule so CSV/JSON are consistent.

alex: I'll draft the schema change we need (flat export fields): event_type, timestamp, actor_principal, actor_principal_type, resource_id, kms_key_id, request_id, outcome. We should include a boolean column kms_redacted when normalization was applied.

jordan: UI: will hide export button for roles without audit.export, and show a tooltip "Exports require export permission". I'll also add a small UX change: "Export will include up to 50k rows; use API for larger ranges" to surface the pagination limit.

samir: I'll update exporter to treat both cursor names and to retry/concat pages until no cursor. Also will add a flag to use full mode (compact=false) for Console exports while schema mapping is built.

security-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-214: "console audit export missing nested fields + pagination token mismatch" assigned to alex/jordan/samir.

maria: Thanks. Priority: P1 for Dedicated customer impact. Can we target a patch this week to stop compact mode + fix token handling, then follow-up with schema bump + RBAC fix?

alex: Yes. Patch plan: quick rollback of compact mode and token fix -> deploy patch + smoke tests (export of synthetic events with kms/actor fields). Follow-up PRs for schema and UI RBAC. I'll own schema + backend. jordan owns UI. samir owns infra exporter behavior. olivia will sign-off on normalization rules.

maria: Great. Please add a short regression test: create service-account rotate events and assert exported CSV includes actor_type and kms_key_id columns populated.

jordan: Will add UI e2e that asserts export button visibility maps to audit.export perm.

maria: tagging for visibility. :thumbsup:
